author: Simon Childs
title: Trump Lashes Out at Data Centre Opponents: ‘You’ll End up Backwards and Poor’
content:
Donald Trump has criticised opponents to AI

data centres

, saying “they want to end up being backwards and poor”.


In a post on Truth Social, the US president said: “If they want to be successful and rich, with far lower taxes and jobs all over the place, let Data Reign.”


Opposition to data centres is growing across the US ahead of November’s midterm elections. In the first three months of 2026, 75 data centre projects worth approximately $130bn were cancelled, according to research group Data Centre Watch.


Three quarters of Americans oppose data centres,

according to a poll

 by environmental news organisation Heatmap Pro.


The

opposition

 is notable for

its breadth

 across the political spectrum. Leftwing Democrats Bernie Sanders and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez have called for a national moratorium, but opposition has also come from conservatives.


In Texas, Republican governor Greg Abbott came out against data centres in August, having previously called the state the “epicentre of AI development”. In Michigan, Republican senate candidate Mike Rogers has called for a moratorium on the construction of new data centres in the state.


While Trump has thrown his support behind data centres, his former chief strategist Steve Bannon has been mobilising Maga activists against AI.


Aaron Regunberg, a commissioning editor at left-leaning magazine New Republic,

has written that the movement

 against data centres may “constitute the best opportunity we’ve had in generations to truly shake up American politics, by redirecting the partisan anger that oligarchic forces have long used to divide regular Americans and channeling that energy instead against the billionaires that are actually the cause of so many of our shared problems.”


Among Republicans who identify as Maga, 45% say building data centres is good, while 29% say it’s bad, according to

 a poll by the Economist and YouGov

. Non-Maga Republicans are net negative on the data centres, with 31% saying building them is good and 35% saying it’s bad.


“The good news is that there are plenty of other places that want them,” Trump added on Truth Social. “If we kill the Golden Goose, you will only have yourselves to blame.”

author: CMI Argentina
title: Se presenta el informe sobre sistema penal de la CPM en Moreno
content:
Será este jueves 3 de septiembre a las 18 hs en la Universidad Nacional de Moreno. El sistema de la crueldad XX es una sistematización del trabajo que el organismo realiza año a año en su calidad de Mecanismo Local de Prevención de la Tortura de la provincia de Buenos Aires y que analiza las políticas públicas vinculadas al sistema penal, penitenciarias, de seguridad, de salud mental y de niñez y adolescencia. Participarán Dora Barrancos (presidenta CPM), Roberto Cipriano García (secretario CPM), Marcelo Giacoia (docente UNM), Guillermo Cony (coordinador-vicedecano de la carrera de Abogacía) y Alejandro Otero (Director-Decano del Departamento de Ciencias Económicas y Jurídicas).


Después de su presentación pública en La Plata, este encuentro en el ámbito de la universidad se plantea como un espacio clave para sensibilizar e interpelar las prácticas y las complejas dinámicas de vulneración de derechos en ámbitos institucionales y proveer el acceso directo a indicadores de violencia institucional. en coordinación con el Programa de Promoción de los Derechos Humanos, que funciona en la órbita de la Secretaría de Extensión Universitaria, esta presentación busca fomentar el debate y la reflexión crítica sobre la articulación de las políticas de seguridad y las deudas pendientes de la democracia en materia de derechos humanos, permitiendo examinar la adecuación de los dispositivos institucionales a los estándares constitucionales e internacionales.


En su diagnóstico la CPM consigna que hoy la Provincia tiene casi el doble de personas detenidas en el sistema penal de adultos que hace 10 años y la tortura sigue siendo una práctica sistemática en los lugares de encierro y el despliegue de las fuerzas de seguridad sin que se implementen políticas destinadas a revertirla. También se incrementaron los casos de uso letal de la fuerza por parte de las fuerzas de seguridad y la cantidad de menores de 16 años detenidos. A esto se suma la emergencia de las nuevas patrullas municipales que actúan como cuerpos policiales, que detienen y usan armas sin estar legalmente habilitados.


“Las llamadas ‘políticas de seguridad’ no son un problema técnico ni de diseño sino uno de los instrumentos de legitimación de la desigualdad en tanto criminaliza la pobreza, la expone y la reduce a un problema del sistema penal”, señala la Comisión Provincial por la Memoria en la introducción de su 20° informe anual. Mediante esta serie de presentaciones del material buscan aportar a la  discusión pública sobre los derechos humanos y la construcción de un proyecto que ponga la dignidad de las mayorías por encima de las pretensiones de los sectores de poder que exacerban  la violencia y el odio hacia los sectores más vulnerables.

Die Bundestagsabgeordneten Ates Gürpinar (Die Linke) und Janosch Dahmen (Bündnis 90/Die Grünen) haben jeweils vor dem Bundesverfassungsgericht versucht, die Abstimmung im letzten Moment zu verhindern. author: CMI Argentina
title: Municipales bonaerenses sufrieron una pérdida salarial de entre el 80 y el 90%
content:
Las y los trabajadores municipales bonaerenses han perdido más del 90% del poder adquisitivo en los últimos años y en 2026 hay municipios que pagaron aguinaldos en agosto o adeudan horas extras.


 


Escuchá el reporte de Cecilia Mársico desde FM Chapaleofú.


Carlos Campos, Secretario de Planificación y Estrategia de la Federación de  Trabajadores Municipales de la Provincia de Buenos Aires, dijo que la situación es grave y que reciben consultas permanentes porque hay trabajadores que no llegan al día diez de cada mes: “La situación es grave, la situación es muy complicada, hay una situación social que nadie está viendo. Para sacar cuál es la pérdida del poder adquisitivo tenés que tener el dato de la inflación y ese dato hoy no es real, la inflación es mentirosa”.


La precarización que sufren los y las municipales se repite en todo el país. Desde la Federación marcaron algunas de esas situaciones como el pago de parte del salario en cifras no remunerativas o la condición de monotributistas frente al municipio, lo que además desfinancia las cajas y prestadoras provinciales y que aportan a ARCA y no al sistema de recaudación provincial .


Campos explicó la importancia de cumplir con la puesta en marcha del Consejo Consultivo, que debe convocar el Ministerio de Trabajo bonaerense. En ese espacio, no vinculante, Municipios y representantes de sindicatos discuten y trabajan los reclamos gremiales.


“Azul terminó de pagar los aguinaldos los días de julio y los primeros de agosto, que en la actualidad tenemos un conflicto laboral en Villa Gesell porque el intendente no paga las horas extras de hace ocho o nueve meses atrás. Todas situaciones que aisladas tal vez no tengan la resonancia que tienen que tener”.


Por último, el secretario aseguró: “Tal vez en el consejo consultivo podamos presentar todas nuestras inquietudes y de una vez por todas los municipales dejemos ser el último orejón del tarro, porque en época de campaña somos los principales artífices de las necesidades de los intendentes”.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: Amid Severe Water Crisis & Drought, Puerto Rico Marks 10 Years of "La Junta" Oversight
content:
Juan Carlos Dávila reports from Puerto Rico as the island grapples with a severe water crisis. A record-breaking drought has led to severe shortages and a system of water rationing that residents say could have been prevented by better infrastructure maintenance. Climate scientists have warned for years that changing weather conditions in the Caribbean are likely to exacerbate existing infrastructure failings, but rather than address the root cause of the water shortage, explains Dávila, a pattern of government inaction and failed public services is used to justify increasing privatization.


Puerto Rico’s water woes come 10 years after the United States passed the bankruptcy law

PROMESA

 to restructure the U.S. territory’s debt, installing an unelected board colloquially known as “La Junta” that continues to hold sweeping authority to determine fiscal and public policy. “This water crisis taking place right now in Puerto Rico, also La Junta bears some responsibility on it,” says Puerto Rican investigative reporter Luis Valentín. “It did not reduce the debt, and [so] pretty much crowds out resources that could be used for infrastructure work.”

title: Trumps Angriffe auf die Pressefreiheit und unabhängige Medien als „Feinde des Volkes“
content:
Dossier


„

… Von dem Moment an, als Trump ins Amt zurückkehrte, hat seine zweite Regierungsmannschaft einer Reihe von rechtsextremen Einflussnehmern und Nachrichtenagenturen Zugang und Status verschafft, darunter auch Persönlichkeiten mit zweifelhafter Vergangenheit und dünnen oder nicht vorhandenen journalistischen Referenzen. Auf diese Weise hat die Regierung einen Schwall schmeichelhafter Medienberichterstattung geschaffen, eine hauchdünne Blase um jede ihrer Entscheidungen, egal wie destruktiv oder inkohärent sie auch sein mag. Diese neuen staatlichen Medien zeigen bedingungslose Loyalität, und ihre Propaganda-Pipeline ist schneller als je zuvor und stellt sicher, dass jede Durchführungsverordnung oder jeder neue Schritt des Ministeriums für Regierungseffizienz in dem Moment, in dem er bekannt gegeben wird, mit begeisterter Pseudo-Berichterstattung begrüßt wird…“

Aus dem engl.

Artikel von Anna Merlan vom 25. Februar 2025 in Mother Jones

 

 – siehe mehr Informationen, auch zum Widerstand:


Visum als Maulkorb: Trump droht ausländischen JournalistInnen mit neuen Visa-Beschränkungen in den USA – Gewerkschaft The NewsGuild klagt, djv protestiert


US-Journalisten-Verband reicht Klage ein: Trump attackiert erneut Pressefreiheit – Journalisten in den Vereinigten Staaten drohen neue Visa-Beschränkungen


„… Unter den ausländischen Korrespondenten und Reportern, die aus den USA berichten, herrscht derzeit große Aufregung. Grund dafür sind die von der US-Regierung angekündigten Änderungen im Visa-Verfahren, die im kommenden Monat in Kraft treten sollen. Die Visa-Gültigkeitsdauer für ausländische Journalisten würde dann drastisch verkürzt werden. Künftig sollen die meisten Journalisten-Visa auf acht Monate begrenzt werden. Bislang waren Aufenthalte von bis zu fünf Jahren möglich. Mehrere Organisationen, darunter der amerikanische Journalisten-Verband The NewsGuild, haben Klage gegen die geplanten Änderungen eingereicht. Die Kläger wollen eine einstweilige Verfügung erzielen, um die neuen Beschränkungen vorerst auszusetzen. „Diese Regeländerungen sind nur ein weiterer Versuch dieser Regierung, die Berichterstattung talentierter Journalisten zu unterbinden. […] Unsere Demokratie ist auf Journalismus angewiesen, und der Journalismus hängt von Journalistinnen und Journalisten aller Art ab“, sagte der Präsident von The NewsGuild Jon Schleuss in einer Erklärung. Die Trump-Regierung unterbreitete bereits im August 2025 den Vorschlag, die Visumsdauer für Journalisten zu verkürzen. Das Heimatschutzministerium DHS begründet seine Entscheidung damit, dass Visumsinhaber einer gründlicheren Überprüfung unterzogen werden müssten und das aktuelle System Sicherheitslücken aufweise. (…) Mehr als 100 internationale Medienorganisation und Verbände, die sich für Pressefreiheit einsetzen, haben seit letztem Jahr die US-Regierung dazu aufgefordert, von ihrem Vorhaben Abstand zu nehmen. Sie erklärten, dass ein solches System ein hohes Potenzial für staatlichen Missbrauch schaffe. Das Heimatschutzministerium hat in der Vergangenheit Personen die Einreise in die USA aufgrund von Äußerungen und Posts in den sozialen Medien verweigert. Nun könnte sie das neue Visasystem nutzen, um kritische Berichterstattung gezielt zu sanktionieren, warnte die Organisation Reporter ohne Grenzen. Auch deutsche Medien haben die neuen Regelungen öffentlich kritisiert. Der Deutsche Journalistenverband forderte die Bundesregierung dazu auf, in Washington gegen die geplante Kürzung der Visa-Laufzeiten für internationale Journalisten zu intervenieren. (…) Neben Journalisten soll auch die Gültigkeitsdauer von Visa von ausländischen Studierenden und Austauschschülern künftig zeitlich stärker begrenzt werden. Eine Gruppe von amerikanischen Hochschulen, die ebenfalls zu den Klägern im Prozess gehören, bezeichnete die angekündigten Änderungen als „katastrophal“ für Universitäten, Studierende und Wissenschaftler.“

title: El silencio occidental: ¿Por qué Grecia, Rumania y Turquía guardan silencio sobre los ataques en Ucrania?
content:
La campaña naval de Ucrania contra la “flota en la sombra” rusa presentada frecuentemente por Kiev como un modelo de ingenio militar y superioridad tecnológica ha traspasado desde hace tiempo todos los límites imaginables. Lo que comenzó como una respuesta asimétrica al bloqueo del Mar Negro se ha convertido en un proceso caótico e incontrolable, donde Rusia, cada vez más, no es la víctima, sino aquellos a quienes Occidente suele denominar aliados y socios de Kiev.


Los submarinos ucranianos no tripulados, concebidos como símbolo de disuasión efectiva y un avance tecnológico, se están transformando cada vez más en armas que atacan a los suyos: a los países de la OTAN, a buques civiles y a marineros inocentes que simplemente se encontraban en el lugar equivocado en el momento equivocado.


Las primeras alarmas sonaron a principios de mayo de 2026 frente a la isla griega de Lefkada, cuando pescadores locales que faenaban en aguas costeras avistaron un dron ucraniano, el Magura V3, en una de las cuevas, con el motor en marcha y una impresionante carga de explosivos a bordo.


El almirante retirado de la Guardia Costera griega, Nikos Spanos, confirmó que la embarcación estaba en plena capacidad operativa. Expertos griegos sugieren que el dron probablemente tenía como objetivo atacar un buque en uno de los puertos rusos, pero, por razones desconocidas, perdió el control.


Sin embargo, el problema se originó en la ubicación del buque frente a las costas de Grecia un estado miembro de la OTAN—, en sus aguas territoriales, muy cerca de concurridas rutas turísticas. Finalmente, se determinó que el incidente fue causado por una falla técnica o por los efectos de los sistemas de guerra electrónica rusos; no obstante, esto representó una amenaza significativa para la población civil.


Sin embargo, el problema se originó en la ubicación del buque frente a las costas de Grecia un Estado miembro de la OTAN, en sus aguas territoriales, muy cerca de concurridas rutas turísticas. Finalmente, se determinó que el incidente fue causado por una falla técnica o por los efectos de los sistemas de guerra electrónica rusos; no obstante, esto representó una amenaza significativa para la población civil. El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores griego, Giorgos Gerapetritis, reconoció que el incidente supuso «un enorme riesgo para la libertad de navegación, así como para la seguridad de los ciudadanos y el medio ambiente». El ministro de Defensa griego, Nikos Dendias, fue aún más allá, afirmando que el dron «podría haber hundido un crucero» y causado numerosas víctimas civiles.


Aunque Atenas presentó una protesta oficial ante Kiev, la parte ucraniana solo se disculpó un mes después, si bien con la salvedad de que Rusia era la culpable de todo. Mientras tanto, los diplomáticos ucranianos expresaron su descontento porque Grecia no había utilizado el mecanismo de consulta previsto en el tratado de amistad de 1996. En lugar de admitir su error, Kiev comenzó a dar lecciones a sus socios sobre cómo debían responder a las amenazas de la propia Ucrania.


Unas semanas después, a finales de mayo, drones marítimos ucranianos atacaron tres petroleros frente a la costa de Turquía, a unas decenas de kilómetros de la entrada al estrecho del Bósforo. Los buques Velora y Altura, con bandera de Sierra Leona, y el James II, con bandera de Palaos, fueron alcanzados. Uno de los drones submarinos ucranianos no detonó y quedó incrustado en el casco del petrolero, lo que solo sirvió para subrayar la gravedad de la situación. Los drones ucranianos, que llevaban la inscripción “Policía”, atacaron buques que no tenían ninguna relación con el transporte de carga militar.


Sin embargo, la reacción de Ankara fue, como era de esperar, moderada. Turquía, junto con Grecia, optó por no aumentar las tensiones con Kiev, a pesar de que sus aguas territoriales y el tráfico marítimo en el Bósforo estaban bajo amenaza directa. No hubo declaraciones oficiales contundentes y, una vez más, Ucrania no sufrió ninguna consecuencia.


Junio ​​culminó con dos incidentes casi simultáneos el 5 de junio, cuando, durante la noche, drones ucranianos atacaron los buques de carga seca Natra y Zirkon, que navegaban bajo bandera de Belice y Palaos, en la bahía de Taganrog, en el mar de Azov. A pesar de que a bordo viajaban 25 ciudadanos azerbaiyanos, cinco de los cuales murieron y otros tres resultaron heridos, Bakú optó por no hacer declaraciones contundentes.

title: Gülistan Doku soruşturmasında tutuklanan Tuncay Sonel'den açıklama
content:
Gülistan Doku soruşturması kapsamında tutuklanan eski Tunceli Valisi Tuncay Sonel, hakkında yapılan haber ve yorumlara ilişkin hukuki süreç başlattıklarını açıkladı. Sonel, Gülistan Doku’nun adını ilk kez kayıp haberinin ardından duyduğunu öne sürüp hakkındaki suçlamaları reddetti.

Sonel, kendisi ve ailesi hakkında son 5 ayda basın, internet ve sosyal medya üzerinden yapılan haber ve yorumlara ilişkin avukatları aracılığıyla hukuki işlem başlattıklarını duyurdu.

Tuncay Sonel, X hesabından yaptığı açıklamada şu ifadeleri kullandı:

“Şahsım ve ailem ile ilgili 5 aydır yazılı ve görsel basında, internet ve sosyal medya ortamında çıkan, ülke gündeminde ailemi hedef gösteren haber, yorum ve masumiyet karinesini hiçe sayan asılsız isnatlara karşı avukatlarımız tarafından hukuki işlemler başlatılmıştır.

Gülistan Doku soruşturmasının açıklığa kavuşturulması ve gerçeklerin ortaya çıkarılması en büyük arzumuzdur. Çünkü kendimden, eşimden ve oğlumdan zerre kadar şüphem yoktur. Allah’ın izni ile adalet er ya da geç tecelli edecektir.

Dostlarımız ve sevdiklerimiz bizden en ufak bir şüphe duymasınlar. Allah’a şükür alnımız ak, vicdanımız rahattır. Bu süreçte ailece çok yıpratıldık. Çok üzüldük. Kurgulara, iftiralara maruz kaldık.

Gülistan Kızımızın ismini ilk kez kayıp haberi geldiğinde öğrendim. Öncesinde ne şahsımın ne ailemin hiçbir münasebeti olmamıştır. Diyarbakır’dan Tunceli’ye gelen ailesine de Devletimizin şefkatini göstermeye, iyi niyetlerimizle onların yanında olmaya ve onlara destek vermeye çalıştık.

Ucu nereye dokunursa dokunsun inşallah gerçekler bir an önce ortaya çıkar da bizler de ailece haksız, asılsız isnatlarla muhatap kalmayız. Ailemizle, sevdiklerimizle en kısa sürede Allah’ın izniyle bir araya geliriz.”

title: 20. Karaburun Bilim Kongresi “emek/emekçiler” temasıyla başlıyor
content:
Görsel: Karaburun Bilim Kongresi afişi

İzmir – Karaburun Bilim Kongresi, 20. yılında “emek/emekçiler” temasıyla 3-5 Eylül tarihleri arasında İzmir’in Karaburun ilçesinde gerçekleştirilecek. Kongrede, küresel kapitalizmin derinleşen çelişkileri, emek-sermaye ilişkileri, emek rejimleri, sınıf mücadelesi ve emeğin örgütlenmesi farklı boyutlarıyla ele alınacak.

Kongre programında, sermayenin hareket serbestisini güvence altına alan politikalarla birlikte emek üzerindeki sömürü, denetim ve kontrolün yoğunlaştığına dikkat çekiliyor. Sendikasızlaştırma, grev yasakları, iş güvencesizliği, ücretlerin yaşam maliyetlerinin gerisinde kalması ve işsizliğin yaygınlaşması, küresel emek rejiminin temel sorunları arasında sıralanıyor.

Bu çerçevede kongre, dünya ve Türkiye ölçeğinde emek-sermaye ilişkilerini ekonomi politik, devlet, siyaset, emek rejimleri ve örgütlenme başlıkları üzerinden tartışmayı amaçlıyor.

Kongrenin açılışı 3 Eylül Perşembe günü “Emeğin Dönüştürücü Gücü” başlıklı oturumla yapılacak. Üç gün boyunca düzenlenecek paralel oturumlarda emeğin güncel sorunları farklı başlıklar altında tartışılacak.

Programda “Hegemonya, devlet ve sınıf mücadelesi”, “Uygarlık krizi, ekoloji ve emek”, “LGBTİ+ emekçiler ve cis-heteronormatif emek rejimi”, “Bakım emeğinin çok boyutlu dönüşümü”, “Dijitalleşme, yapay zekâ ve emek”, “Akademi ve emek”, “Alternatif emek örgütlenmeleri” ve “Kamu emekçilerinin geleceği” başlıkları yer alıyor.

Ayrıca “Sendikal mücadele: kriz ve arayışlar”, “Platform ekonomisinde kuryelik ve güvencesizlik” ile “Emeğin sanatsal görünümleri” başlıklarında da oturumlar gerçekleştirilecek.

Kongrenin son günü olan 5 Eylül Cumartesi günü “Demokrasi ve Emek Mücadelesi” başlıklı oturumda DEM Parti, EMEP, Sol Parti, TİP ve Yeni Parti temsilcileri bir araya gelecek.

Kapanış oturumunda ise sendikal hareketin güncel sorunları ve olanakları tartışılacak. “Sınıf Mücadelesinde Açmazlar ve Olanaklar” başlıklı oturuma DİSK/Dev Yapı-İş, Limter-İş, BİRTEK-SEN ve DGD-SEN’den temsilciler katılacak.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: The Biggest Oil Deal or Theft at Gunpoint? U.S. Claims Majority Control of Venezuela's Oil Reserves
content:
The U.S. has struck a deal to take majority control of more than 65 billion barrels of Venezuela’s oil reserves, nine months after the U.S. military abducted President Nicolás Maduro and his wife Cilia Flores in a raid on Caracas and two months after

The New York Times

 revealed that U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio has become the

de facto

 viceroy of Venezuela, effectively controlling Venezuela’s finances, the distribution of its natural resources and its government. The new oil deal gives the Department of Defense a 35% stake in a joint U.S.-Venezuelan private company that now holds 100-year leases to 17 oil fields. It also gives the U.S. the right to buy some of the oil produced at cost — a major triumph for the Trump administration as the war on Iran depletes the United States’ strategic oil reserves. Venezuela’s acting President Delcy Rodríguez claims U.S. investment in Venezuela’s oil industry will jumpstart the country’s floundering economy, but critics, including Venezuelan economist Francisco Rodríguez, say the deal is not only “unfavorable to Venezuela” but also appears to violate the Venezuelan Constitution.


“The whole history around this is extremely shady,” adds Rodríguez, who previously led Venezuela’s Congressional Budget Office and now teaches at the University of Denver. “It’s clear that this is not a deal that any Venezuelan government would have entered into unless this country had been subject to an invasion, and unless its authorities had been held at gunpoint. So, I think we’ve replaced gunboat diplomacy now for gunpoint diplomacy.”

author: Joshua Carroll
title: Fromer Prime Minister Keir Starmer Resigns As MP
content:
Keir Starmer is resigning as an MP to focus on “international affairs” and “protecting women and girls”.


The former prime minister, who supported Israel as it killed

at least 38,000 women and girls

 in Gaza, will stand down from his seat in Holborn and St Pancras in London, triggering a byelection.


“I will now focus on other things and that will be international affairs including defence, security, trade and technology in a fast-changing world,”

he told

 the Camden New Journal newspaper.


“I will also continue, as I have done for a long time now with others, to work on combating violence against women and girls; that is an issue that matters to me hugely. It’s work I started before I became an MP and it’s work I’m keen to continue after I’m an MP.”


Starmer is

reportedly interested

 in becoming secretary general of Nato, a role that is set to fall vacant in 2028.

title: Süleyman cemaatine operasyon: Korku saltanatı yıkılmaya mahkum
content:
Marmara Üniversitesi öğrencisi Eylül ODTÜ Öğrencisi Yahya

13 Ağustos’ta Ankara Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığının yürüttüğü soruşturma kapsamında aralarında şu anki liderleri olan Alihan Kuriş’in de dahil olduğu 49 kişi hakkında gözaltı kararı çıkartılıp; 17 ilde 30 kişi yasadışı örgüt kurmak, suç örgütüne üye olmak, kamu kurum ve kuruluşlarının zararına dolandırıcılık gibi suçlarla göz altına alınmış olup, 16 Ağustos 2026 tarihinde Kuriş de dahil olmak üzere 32 şüpheli tutuklandı. Nakşibendi tarikatına mensup olan Süleymancılar veya kendi tabirleriyle Süleymanlılar, 1951 yılında kurulmuş olup günümüzde faaliyetlerine devam etmektedir. Bünyelerinde birçok medrese, dernek, yurt ve basım yayın araçları bulundurmaktadırlar.

Süleymancılar yeni bir tarikat kolu olmamakla birlikte siyasetin içinde uzun yıllardır var olup devlet içinde derinleşmişlerdir. Cemaatin faaliyetlerinin kurumsallaşmasında 1960’ların ikinci yarısı ve 1970’li yıllardaki mevzuat değişiklikleri etkili olmuştur. Süleymancıların örgütlenmesi sadece yurtiçi ile sınırlı değildir. Diyanet raporuna göre yapı, 1961’de başlayan işçi göçünün ardından Avrupa’da İslam Kültür Merkezleri adı altında Kur’an kursları açan ilk gruplardan biri oldu.

Bugün genişleyerek Almanya’da STK gibi yapılanmalar oluşturmuşlardır. Süleymancıların yakın geçmişine baktığımızda tıpkı Gülen Cemaati gibi devletin ve siyasetin içinde bulundukları görülüyor. 80 darbesi öncesi Süleyman Demirel iktidarıyla yakın ilişkiler kurmuşlardır, darbe döneminde partilerin kapatılmasıyla ve gücün 12 Eylül cuntasına geçmesiyle beraber, cunta rejiminin isteklerine uymaları amacıyla önce tutuklanıp daha sonra sol görüş için bir panzehir oldukları düşünülerek serbest bırakılmış ve cunta yönetimiyle anlaşarak faaliyetlerine Amerika ve onun kuklası olan yönetimin Yeşil Kuşak Projesine uygun biçimde devletçi, düşünmeyen, siyasal İslamcı bir nesil yetiştirmek amacına uygun bir biçimde devam etmişlerdir.

Özal döneminde Türkiye’de neoliberal politikalar izlenmeye başlamıştır. Bu politikalarla birlikte özelleştirmenin artması, kamu kuruluşlarının sermayenin eline bırakılması ile cemaat sadece bağışlarla dönen bir yapı olmaktan çıkıp kendi vakıfları ve cemaat mensuplarının kurdukları şirketler aracılığıyla kayda değer bir ekonomik güce ulaşmışlardır. Yine aynı dönemde cemaat, ülkedeki güç odağına gelme çabasıyla ANAP’tan milletvekilleri ve milletvekili adayları çıkarmıştır.

Daha sonrasında cemaat siyasetle iç içe olmaya devam etmiş, 28 Şubat askeri müdahalesinin ardından cemaat siyasette daha çok sızmış, bu doğrultuda zamanın Refah Partisinden Milletvekili seçilen Arif Ahmet Denizolgun tarikatın o zamanki lideri- daha sonrasında kurulan koalisyon hükümetinde Ulaştırma Bakanlığı yapmış ve Marmaray’ın projesi onun zamanında ortaya atılıp özel şirketlere para akıtma yolu aranmıştır.

Türkiye’de yıllardır sıkça tartışılan önemli konulardan biri de tarikat yurtları mevzusudur. Süleymancıların 900’den fazla derneği bulunmaktadır. Bu dernekler aracılığıyla kendi yurtlarını açmaktadırlar, hemen hemen Türkiye’nin her ilçesinde yurt ve pansiyonları bulunmakta olup sayıları 1300 civarındadır. Bunun dışında pek çok kayıt dışı yurtları da mevcuttur. Tüm bunların yanında 20 civarında vakıf ve 30'un üzerinde şirketle yurt içinde ve yurt dışında organize olmuşlardır yıl içinde tahmini ortalama 100.000 öğrenciye “eğitim” vermektedir. Türkiye’deki yoksulluğun derinleşmesiyle birlikte okumak isteyen öğrencilere sunulan barınma imkanların yetersizliği ölçüsünde özellikle şehir dışından gelen öğrencilerin özel yurt veya eve çıkma olanağının oldukça zor olmasından dolayı bu sistemde hayatta kalmak zorunda olan öğrenciler cazip ücretlerde olan cemaat yurt ve pansiyonlarına mecbur bırakılmışlardır. Sadece Türkiye vatandaşları değil yurt dışından gelen öğrencileri de tarikat yurtlarına yerleştirmekte olup, insanları bu düzene mahkum etmektedir.

Özellikle Saray rejimi ile beraber tarikat yurtlarında yüzde 90’dan fazla artış yaşanmıştır. Gündeme sıkça gelen ve çoğunlukla ortaokul veya lise yurtlarında yaşanan darp, taciz ve istismar olayları yüzünden bu yurtlarda birçok intihar ve kendine zarar verme kayıtları bulunmaktadır. Türkiye’de günümüzde açıkça görülebileceği ve bu yazıyı okuyan herkesin anlayabileceği şekilde büyük bir cemaat sorunu vardır, bu sorun 80 darbesi sonrası devlet politikaları ile doğrudan ilişkilidir. title: Eski Merkez Bankası Başkanı Gaye Erkan'a komşularından ihtarname: Ortak yaşamı diğer kat malikleri açısından çekilmez hale getirdiniz!
content:
Türkiye Cumhuriyet Merkez Bankası YouTube kanalında yayımlanan "Enflasyon Raporu 2023-IV Bilgilendirme Toplantısı" başlıklı canlı yayından ekran görüntüsü alınmıştır

Türkiye Cumhuriyeti Merkez Bankası (TCMB) eski başkanı Hafize Gaye Erkan’ın Bodrum’daki villasında komşularıyla yaşadığı sorunlar yargıya taşınıyor. Evin bulunduğu Çağdaş Turgut Reis Tatil Evleri Sitesi Yönetimi, Erkan’a noter aracılığıyla ihtarname göndererek Kat Mülkiyeti Kanunu kapsamında mülkiyetin devri davası açılabileceğini bildirdi.

Ekonomim yazarı Sadi Özdemir’in aktardığı bilgilere göre, Erkan’ın 1,3 milyon avroya satın aldığı villada süregelen yaşamı site sakinlerinin tepkisine yol açtı. , 28 Ağustos 2026 tarihinde noter kanalıyla Gaye Erkan’a iletilen ihtarnamede “ortak yaşamın diğer kat malikleri açısında çekilmez hale geldiği” ifadeleri kullanıldı.

Özdemir’in köşe yazısında yer alan bilgilere göre, söz konusu ihtarnamede şu ifadeler yer aldı:

"Ortak yaşamın diğer kat malikleri açısından çekilmez hale gelmesine neden olan eylemlerinizin devam etmesi ve gerekli yükümlülüklere riayet edilmemesi halinde 634 Sayılı Kat Mülkiyeti Kanununun 25’inci Maddesi kapsamında bağımsız bölümünüzün mülkiyetinin devri için dava açılması da dahil olmak üzere müvekkil site yönetiminin sahip olduğu tüm yasal hak ve başvuru yollarına başvurulacağına, bu kapsamda doğacak yargılama giderleri ile vekâlet ücretinin tarafınıza yükletilmesinin talep edileceğini ihtaren bildiririz."

Öte yandan, site yönetimi personelinden 7 kişinin de Hafize Gaye Erkan hakkında "hakaret, tehdit ve şiddet" iddialarıyla savcılığa suç duyurusunda bulunduğu öne sürüldü.

9 Haziran 2023 - 3 Şubat 2024 tarihleri arasında yaklaşık 8 ay TCMB Başkanlığı görevini yürüten Erkan, görev süresi boyunca konut kiralarına ilişkin yaptığı açıklamalarıyla dikkat çekmişti.

title: Li Amedê serlêdanên ji bo Konservatuvara Bajar a Aram Tîgranî dest pê kirin
content:
Şaredariya Bajarê Mezin a Amedê aşkere kir ku di çarçoveya xebatên parastin, pêşxistin û veguhastina mîrata çandî û hunerî de li Konservatuvara Bajar a Aram Tîgran a girêdayî Serokatiya Beşa Karên Çandî, Hunerî û Civakî serdema qeydên xwendekaran dest pê kiriye.


Konservatuvara ku di sala 2010an de hatibû avakirin û di 1ê Mijdara 2016an de ji aliyê qeyim ve hatibû girtin, piştî 9 salan ji aliyê Şaredariya Bajarê Mezin ve ji nû ve hate vekirin. Di serdemê nû de jî di şaxên cuda yên hunerê de perwerdehî bi temamî bêpere bê dayîn. Serlêdanên serdemê nû yên konservatuvarê dê di navbera 1-20ê Îlonê ya 2026an de bê kirin.


Li Konservatuvara Bajar a Aram Tîgran ku dê bi kontenjana sînordar xwendekaran qebûl bike; beşên sînema, şano, muzîk, muzîka zarokan, ziman û wêjeya kurdî û govend cih digirin. Bi bernameyên perwerdehiyê re tê armanckirin ku piştgiriya pêvajoyên hilberîna hunerî ya beşdaran bê kirin û hafizaya çandî ya bajar bo nifşên nû bê veguhastin. Hemû dersên atolyeyê yên li konservatuvarê dê li Navenda Çand û Kongreyê ya Çand Amedê bêne lidarxistin.


Perwerdehiya muzîkê ya ji bo 6 salan


Zarokên di navbera temenê 7-12an de dê bikaribin ji beşa muzîka zarokan a li konservatuvarê sûd werbigirin. Di beşa ku zimanê wê yê perwerdehiyê kurdî ye de, dê 6 salan perwerdehiya muzîkê ji zarokan re bê dayîn. Bi vê bernameya perwerdehiyê ya demdirêj re tê armanckirin ku di temenê biçûk de şiyana zarokan a di qada muzîkê de derkeve holê û bi pêvajoyeke perwerdehiyê ya sîstematîk were pêşxistin.


Pêşbirk di 21yê Îlonê de ye


Piştî qedandina serlêdanan, atolyeyên hilbijartina xwendekaran dê di navbera 21-27ê Îlonê de li Navenda Çand û Kongreyê ya Çand Amedê bêne çêkirin. Piştî nirxandinên ku di atolyeyan de bêne kirin, xwendekarên ku mafê perwerdehiyê bi dest bixin dê diyar bibin. Encamên atolyeyên hilbijartina xwendekaran dê di 5ê Cotmehê de bêne eşkerekirin, qûrsên serdemê nû yên li Konservatuvara Bajar a Aram Tigran jî dê di 12yê Cotmehê de dest pê bikin.


Ji bo serlêdanê vê lînkê

 bitikîne.

Things like overdraft fees, late fees, parking tickets, fines, subscription renewals, legal fees, penalty fees, sales and discounts, lawsuits - these are things that all cease to matter in any material way once you have enough money

To Jeff Bezos, a parking meter, a plane ticket, and a private jet all effectively cost the same amount of money: none

My wealthiest aunt credits her fortune to her financial acumen.  Last year, her husband died (making her even wealthier), and as she was grieving her children stepped up to help her out with things.

Turns out she is terrible with money.  Like, she had multiple copies of the same subscriptions, was overpaying to keep multiple homes maintained, and generally can’t budget to save her life.  Also, so many things that she assumed were “perks” of her credit card program were actually just her husband paying for upgrades behind her back.

But it doesn’t matter because she already has enough money to make problems go away.  She can afford to be stupid with it and still think of herself as smart and poor people as dumb.

I can’t

stand

 this shit. This is the kind of rich person behavior that simultaneously makes me envious and angry.

I don’t care that they have more

stuff

 than I do, but I do envy that they have more

slack.

That they can afford to forget things, to be inefficient, or wasteful, and it doesn’t matter.

Which is fine by me if you are properly grateful and understand that’s what’s happening, but good lord it drives me up the wall when people who are terrible with money castigate the poor for being bad at money. When the person who has a bunch of duplicate subscription services they forgot about lectures the destitute about how irresponsible it is to order Doordash, I get enraged.

“Do as I say, not as I do” has infuriated me since I was a child and that irritation has never left me.

I do wonder if there is some kind of repressed self-hatred there.

Like a kind of guilt that if you had all this wealth and privilege without “earning” it that would somehow be immoral, or a lingering sense that it’s only luck that you are where you are, so you try to build this synthetic world where actually you

did

 earn it and the reason you’re better off than other people is that you deserve to be.

This is also why I can’t stand Republican approaches to medicaid and food stamps and all that shit, they are so obsessed with taking away slack from the destitute.

A long time ago, I don’t even remember what social media I saw this on, but I saw somebody talking about how they grew up really poor, but had gotten a good job, and how incredible it felt the first time they bought a book because they felt like buying a book.

Because there are a lot of people out there who are going to overdraw their checking account if they spend that $8 on a paperback without carefully looking over their budget.

And I can relate to that. I cannot tell you how much it improved my mental health when I got to the point where

I

 could buy a latte or a paperback and not have to worry that I had completely destroyed my budget for the next month.

I know at least one person who spends as much money as she gets without realizing it, but when I got the freedom to buy a latte if I felt like it?

It got easier not to buy lattes. Because it was my choice, because I could think about putting the money away as savings, not as a choice, and because I knew I could change my mind later, the decision seemed less momentous.

I mean, can you imagine if people sometimes shopped less because of a direct material need, and more as a psychological effort to exert control over their lives?

Why, if that were the case, things like restricting what you can buy with food stamps might actually be counterproductive. But fortunately we live in a world where all economic activity is rational attempts to meet material needs, so that’s not a problem.


I’ve moved from ‘dirt broke’ to 'can just buy stuff without completely destroying my budget’ too and feel the guilt / sense that it’s only luck (because it is luck! title: 1 September and a new era for peace
content:
1 September marks the day when one of the darkest chapters in human history began. The Second World War, which started with Nazi Germany’s invasion of Poland on the morning of 1 September 1939, claimed tens of millions of lives, destroyed cities and left deep social wounds. The search for peace that emerged from the ashes of the war later gave rise to the tradition of commemorating the date as “World Peace Day.” Particularly rooted in Eastern Europe and among left-wing and peace movements, 1 September became a common call for peace among labour, democratic and popular forces in Kurdistan and Turkey from the mid-1980s onwards. Every year on 1 September, the aspiration for a society in which the guns fall silent, justice prevails and peoples can live together through their own free will is voiced anew.


Over the years, 1 September has become one of the most visible and widely attended occasions for expressing the demand for peace in Turkey. Since the 1990s, marches, rallies, press statements and peace festivals have been organised in Istanbul, Ankara, Izmir and many other cities, led by major labour and professional organisations such as the Confederation of Progressive Trade Unions of Turkey (DISK), the Confederation of Public Employees’ Trade Unions (KESK), the Union of Chambers of Turkish Engineers and Architects (TMMOB), the Turkish Medical Association (TTB), as well as the Human Rights Association (IHD) and various democratic civil society organisations. Turkish and Kurdish workers, intellectuals, women and young people have taken part in these events together. A democratic and peaceful solution to the Kurdish question has also remained among their central demands. Every year on 1 September, attention has been drawn to the devastating consequences of war, with an emphasis on the fact that lasting and just peace can only be achieved on the basis of justice, equality and freedom. In this way, 1 September has become established in Turkey as a shared day of peace for the left, the labour movement and democratic sections of society.


The search for a solution was never abandoned


The significance of 1 September has become even deeper in Kurdistan. Years of denial and assimilation policies, coupled with war, turned the Kurdish people’s search for peace into a matter of existence. Even amid the intense conflict of the 1990s, demands for peace were taken to the streets. Marches, rallies and press statements in many cities called for the guns to fall silent, for a dignified peace and for a democratic solution. The central message was the necessity of resolving the Kurdish question through peaceful and democratic means.


Peace, ultimately, is a fundamental right: the right of everyone to live together in security, with their language, identity, faith and cultural background respected. The Kurdish Freedom Movement never abandoned its search for peace and a democratic solution, even after the period of armed struggle began in Eruh (Dih) and Şemdinli (Şemzînan) on 15 August 1984. The movement defined peace as a process in which social justice, identity rights and democratic participation are guaranteed. This approach placed the concept of “dignified peace” at its centre: a peace built on mutual recognition and equality.


The first steps towards peace


The movement continued to take steps towards peace even during the years when the conflict was at its most intense. In March 1993, for example, Abdullah Öcalan declared the first unilateral ceasefire following initiatives by then-President Turgut Özal and mediation by former Iraqi President Jalal Talabani. The ceasefire made clear that the Kurdish question should be resolved through political means within Turkey.


The ceasefire was later extended, but the process was interrupted by Özal’s suspicious death and the developments that followed. Nevertheless, the movement declared a second unilateral ceasefire on 15 December 1995 and a third on World Peace Day, 1 September 1998. The demands remained clear each time: a political solution, democratic rights and lasting peace.


The search for a solution on Imrali


Abdullah Öcalan’s transfer to Turkey on 15 February 1999 as a result of an international conspiracy marked the beginning of a new period. The search for peace continued despite the harsh conditions on Imrali. A fourth ceasefire was declared on 1 September 1999, accompanied by a call for the guerrillas to withdraw beyond Turkey’s borders. The guerrillas responded to …

title: Şema Elî and Mûrad Minbic laid to rest
content:
Hundreds of people from Kobanê attended a ceremony at the Martyr Dicle Cemetery to bid farewell to Internal Security Forces member Şema Elî, who lost her life on 27 August, and Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) fighter Mûrad Minbic (Mihemed Ehmed), who lost his life on 26 December 2024.


Officials and members of the Autonomous Administration’s councils and institutions, as well as representatives of civil society organisations, attended the ceremony.


The ceremony began with a moment of silence. Şêx Ehmed delivered a speech on behalf of the Kobanê Council of Martyrs’ Families, commemorating all those who lost their lives in the freedom struggle. He said the democratic nation project was built on the foundations of fraternity and peace and encompassed all components of Syria.


Şêx Ehmed said building a democratic Syria required the participation of all components and stressed that people from different parts of Syria, Kurdistan and around the world were laid to rest at the Martyr Dicle Cemetery.


Narîn Mistefa, a member of the Kobanê Internal Security Forces Administration, also addressed the ceremony and pledged to follow the path of Şema and all those who had lost their lives. Mistefa stressed that they would continue their efforts to protect the security of the city, the values of the fallen and the gains they had achieved.


The martyrdom certificates of Şema Elî and Mûrad Minbic were then read out and presented to their families.


Their comrades and families laid them to rest at the cemetery amid ululations and slogans.

title: 10 wounded in clashes in Suwayda
content:
According to Syrian state television, the clashes took place on Monday evening. The latest clashes occurred one day after two civilians were killed around Suwayda. Tensions have continued in the region since the overthrow of Bashar al-Assad’s government in late 2024.


The Suwayda Internal Security Command said that security forces had responded to attacks by armed groups in the Tal Hadid area and along the Walgha road. Four people were initially reported wounded, but the number of wounded was later announced to have risen to 10.


Druze armed groups continue to control Suwayda city as well as parts of the province.


An armed group known as the “National Guard,” affiliated with Druze leader Hikmat al-Hijri, accused government forces of attacking civilians. The group said government forces had fired “indiscriminately” with mortars and machine guns, wounding a child.


The group said it had responded to the attacks with “appropriate means” and warned that the government forces’ attacks “would not go unanswered.”

title: Comedian Deniz Göktaş arrested again
content:
Comedian Deniz Göktaş was rearrested following an appeal by the prosecutor concerning two charges for which he had previously been granted release. Göktaş had been detained on charges of “insulting the President” and “inciting the public to hatred and hostility.” Following an objection to his detention filed by his lawyers, a release order was issued on Friday, August 28. However, before Göktaş had even left the prison, he was this time arrested again on a charge of “praising a crime and a criminal” and remained in prison.


According to a report by Medyascope, Göktaş was rearrested on the charges of “insulting the President” and “inciting the public to hatred and hostility” following the prosecutor’s appeal.


With this decision, Deniz Göktaş will remain in detention on three charges.

author: Unknown
title: Women take to the streets on 1 September to raise voice for peace
content:
Women’s struggle for a dignified peace remains one of the key issues in the Peace and Democratic Society Process, which has become a central focus of the country’s agenda.


Socialist Women’s Assemblies (SMA) member Simay Ada Kart spoke to Mezopotamya Agency (MA) about the importance of 1 September. 


Peace is vital for women


Simay Ada Kart said that women are most affected by the policies pursued in times of war. Kart said, “We see that in imperialist and colonial wars, it is women who are made most vulnerable to violence, impoverished and displaced. In this respect, discussing peace today is a matter of vital importance for women.” Kart also referred to the special warfare policies pursued in Kurdistan, saying that women are defined, through family and population policies, as those expected to give birth to soldiers for the colonial war. She pointed to the growing number of femicides and suspicious deaths of women in Turkey and Kurdistan and said: “Gülistan Doku and Rojin Kabaiş are examples of this. Once again, we have clearly seen the systematic attacks of the patriarchal state against Kurdish women.”


Kart said that restrictions and bans on the mother tongue must be brought to an end to achieve a dignified peace and stressed that Kurdish must be granted constitutional status. She said,“We have seen time and again in this region just how important the issue of the mother tongue is to women’s lives and freedom. It is worth recalling Fatma Altınmakas. We are talking about the reality of a woman who was killed after her statement was not taken in her mother tongue when she went to file a complaint.”


The patriarchal state must be confronted


Simay Ada Kart said women are subjected to sexual torture in police custody and removal centres, while those who take to the streets for their rights and demands face attacks and women prisoners are subjected to increasing repression. Kart said those responsible for the intensification of special warfare policies against women, particularly in Kurdistan, must be held to account and confronted. Kart said, “A just and democratic peace is, of course, impossible without confronting the patriarchal state that keeps women under oppression and exploitation, along with all its mechanisms, and without dismantling the material foundations of male domination.”


We must raise our voices in the streets


Kart stressed that women stand for peace and continued: “We women are the subjects of a just and democratic peace. Today is a day when women and oppressed people in many cities will take to the streets and raise their voices to demand peace. In every city and every square, we must raise our voices for a just and democratic peace and an equal and free life. We must take to the streets and strengthen our struggle.”

author: Unknown
title: 10 parties react to Syrian Education Ministry’s decision on Kurdish-language education
content:
Political parties in Rojava issued a joint written statement regarding the decision on Kurdish-language education in schools in the region.


The statement said the decision concerning Kurdish-language education in schools was being closely followed with great concern. According to the decision, Kurdish is limited to only three lessons and one activity per week and is treated as an elective subject. The parties emphasized that this practice does not meet the right to education in one’s mother tongue.


The statement described the decision as unacceptable and rejected it on all grounds, saying that the practice is incompatible with the principles of justice, equality, and linguistic and cultural rights.


The statement continued by saying that Kurdish is not a supplementary subject that students should have the right to choose whether or not to take, nor is it a foreign language in Syria. It stated:


“Kurdish is the mother tongue, identity, history, culture, and collective memory of our people. Any education policy that ignores this reality or diminishes the status of the Kurdish language can be seen not as a step toward building the future of a new Syria, but as a continuation of policies of exclusion and denial.”


The parties rejected the teaching of Kurdish for only three lessons per week, saying this does not meet the needs of Kurdish students. The parties also rejected treating Kurdish as an elective subject for the Kurdish people and called for Kurdish-language educational materials to be used in schools in Kurdish regions.


The statement emphasized that Kurdish and the right to education must be constitutionally guaranteed, and called on the Education Ministry and relevant parties to immediately review the decision. It also called for serious and responsible dialogue with community representatives and relevant stakeholders in the field of education and teaching, and for a fair education policy to be established.


The statement said that protecting Kurdish and the right to education does not mean diminishing the rights of Arabs or other communities in Syria. On the contrary, it said, it means guaranteeing the linguistic and cultural rights of all Syrians.


“The new Syria cannot be built through the continuation of the old mentality and policies of exclusion and denial,” the statement said, emphasizing that there can be no talk of rebuilding Syria without justice, equal citizenship, and respect for the pluralism of Syrian society.


The political parties and movements that signed the statement are:


Democratic Union Party (PYD)


Syrian Kurdish Democratic Party


Kurdish Democratic Unity Party in Syria (YEKÎTÎ)


Kurdish Progressive Democratic Party in Syria


Syrian Kurdish Democratic Party (El-Partî)


Kurdish Left Party in Syria


Kurdish Democratic Accord Party in Syria


Syria Future Party


Kurdistan Freedom Movement in Syria


Kurdistan Democratic Peace Party

title: Antikriegstag 2026: „Friedensfähig statt kriegstüchtig! Gemeinsam für Völkerverständigung, soziale Gerechtigkeit und eine Welt ohne Krieg“ (DGB)
content:
„

Die internationalen Entwicklungen erfüllen den DGB und seine Mitgliedsgewerkschaften mit größter Sorge. Das Weltgeschehen wird zunehmend geprägt durch die Großmachtansprüche der USA, Chinas und Russlands. Für deren Durchsetzung schrecken sie auch vor der Anwendung und Androhung militärischer Gewalt nicht zurück. Wir erheben unsere gewerkschaftliche Stimme dagegen und halten unbeirrbar an unserem Grundsatz fest: „Nie wieder Krieg!“ Die aktuelle politische Debatte verschärft mit ihrer Verengung auf militärische Aspekte von Sicherheit Verteilungskonflikte und schwächt damit den gesellschaftlichen Zusammenhalt sowie die Demokratie selbst. Sicherheit ist für uns kein rein militärisches Projekt

…“

DGB-Erklärung zum Antikriegstag am 1. September 2026 vom 28. Juli 2026

 und u.a. eine Bewertung durch „SAGT NEIN! Gewerkschafter:innen gegen Krieg, Militarismus und Burgfrieden“:


Aufruf von medico international zum 1. September 2026: Ohne uns! Für einen Ausstieg aus der Logik des Krieges


„

Wir leben in Zeiten einer naiven Hoffnung. Während die Nachrichten täglich vom Schrecken des Krieges künden, wird er uns gleichzeitig als Ausweg aus den Problemen unserer Gegenwart verkauft. Fünf Jahre Stellungs- und Abnutzungskrieg in der Ukraine, aber auch 25 Jahre „Krieg gegen den Terror“ oder der Horror von Gaza: Die bestens dokumentierte Sinnlosigkeit des Krieges kann der Hoffnung auf seine Heilungskräfte scheinbar nichts anhaben. Sein Schrecken hat sich stattdessen zum Argument verkehrt, ihm kriegstüchtig beizutreten – und wer diese Logik kritisiert oder bezweifelt, gilt als Nestbeschmutzer:in der demokratischen Zukunft, als naive:r Friedensaktivist:in oder gar als Putinist:in. Wie konnte es so weit kommen?


Der Krieg, das merken wir Tag für Tag, ist weit mehr als ein Schlachtfeld der Körper und Maschinen. Er ist eine Art und Weise, die Welt zu denken, und begründet einen Horizont dessen, was möglich und notwendig scheint. Er wird uns als einzig denkbarer Ausweg aus einer sich unserem Einfluss entziehenden Lage präsentiert, in der sich alles auf eine militärisch zu schaffende Sicherheit reduziert. Wir sollen für Aufrüstung, Wehrdienst und Kriegstüchtigkeit sein, denn einzig die Vorbereitung auf den Krieg soll die ersehnte Sicherheit wieder herstellen können. „Wir sind für Frieden, doch erst müssen wir gewinnen“ heißt es lakonisch bei den Berliner Rappern von K.I.Z. Doch was, wenn der Sieg trotz aller Siegesgewissheit nicht kommt – und der legitime Wunsch nach Sicherheit die Eskalation nur weiter befeuert? (…)


Die Logik des Krieges bestimmt die politische Debatte, Diplomatie und internationale Politik befinden sich auf einem historischen Tiefpunkt. Bereits die Zeitenwende, die nach dem russischen Überfall auf die Ukraine vom damaligen Bundeskanzler Olaf Scholz ausgerufen wurde, suggerierte, dass ein Ende dieses Krieges durch Aufrüstung möglich werde. Die Idee, dass militärische Stärke allein den Frieden sichern kann, wurde trotz ihres offenkundigen Scheiterns in der Ukraine dann zum europäischen Paradigma – und dabei entgrenzt und radikalisiert. Die Grenze zwischen Defensive und Offensive, zwischen Angriff und Verteidigung weicht zunehmend auf. Dabei muss immer neu aus der Wahrnehmung getilgt werden, dass der Krieg in der Ukraine bereits hunderttausende Menschen getötet und Millionen in die Flucht geschlagen hat. (…)


Gefragt ist eine neue internationalistische Debatte. Eine Perspektive, die sich den nationalen Logiken, der geopolitischen Lagerbildung und der Neuauflage eines Kampfes der Kulturen widersetzt. Eine neue internationale Solidarität mit all jenen, die sich – hier wie dort – ein Ende des Krieges wünschen. Sie begründet sich in der gemeinsamen Position russischer, ukrainischer, palästinensischer, israelischer, europäischer und anderer Gegner:innen des Krieges. Es gibt sie, auch wenn sie leise sind oder stumm geschaltet werden.


Gefragt ist außerdem eine neue europäische Idee. (…)


Eine internationale Anti-Kriegs-Bewegung ist überfällig. author: Steven Methven
title: The UK Isn’t Serious About West Bank Settler Violence
content:
This weekend brought yet another surge in the endless surge of Israeli violence in the Palestinian territories. But as the EU and UK get

increasingly vocal over settler attacks

 in the West Bank, it’s well past the time that action, rather than words, was needed. 


Economic measures, we’re told, are on the table, with EU and British leaders meeting to discuss the issue this week. But don’t get your hopes up. The media and our governments have been very busy distinguishing settlers – groups of random stochastic terrorists – from the one entity they’ve yet to succeed in confronting: the state of Israel itself. 


The question is: will they manage it this time, before the West Bank goes up in flames?


There was an article in the New York Times this weekend: “These Generals Fought For Israel,”

 it was titled

, “Now They See ‘Jewish Terrorism’ As The Threat”. 


That phrase in the headline – “Jewish Terrorism” – was used by not one, but over 200 Israelis. All of significant distinction, and many connected to various Israeli state apparatus, they’ve signed a letter that uses the phrase to describe settler violence while condemning the ethnic cleansing of Palestinians from the occupied West Bank. 


“The signatories included two former prime ministers, more than three dozen retired army and air force generals,” the New York Times reported, before going on, “The former heads of the nation’s foreign and domestic intelligence services, as well as rabbis, a Nobel laureate and one of Israel’s most revered novelists”. 


The article comes in the context of the

most violent year on record

 for settler attacks in the West Bank. In the nine months of 2026 so far, 76 Palestinians have been killed in the West Bank by settlers or Israeli forces, 18 of them children. Around 3,600 Palestinians have been displaced by nearly 1,500 settler attacks across the territory. And this terrorism,

according to Human Rights Watch

, is armed, funded and protected by the Israeli state.


The European Union and UK are currently contemplating trade bans on goods from illegal settlements, a tool that’s been on the table but never picked up countless times before. Last month, foreign secretary Ed Miliband summoned Israel’s most senior diplomat in Britain over the country’s inviting firms to bid for contracts to build 1,200 Israeli homes in the so-called E1 zone. That’s a crescent shaped

patch of the West Bank

 that, once fully occupied (over 3,200 homes have been approved by Israel’s government), will cut the north of the Palestinian territory from the south: another hefty nail in the coffin of a contiguous Palestinian state. 


In response, Miliband promised a “

comprehensive set of measures

” to protect the Palestinian state, which was formally recognised by the UK last year. But an article in the Times soon afterwards reported practical difficulties with the plan to target goods and services from settlements. How,

it pondered

, do you distinguish products coming from the occupied West Bank from those produced in Israel? 


The simple answer is: you don’t. 


On Monday, the Financial Times published

an editorial from its board

. Called “Israel’s de facto annexation of the West Bank”, it also argued for targeted sanctions against illegal settlements. The great and the good, it seems, are gathering around a solution they have every reason to believe will be either impossible to enact or ineffective. 


The issue is, of course, right there in the FT’s title. The violent annexation of the West Bank by Israel is hardly ‘de facto’ – it’s Israeli government policy. It’s not random settlers inviting construction firms to begin building on Palestinian land, but Tel Aviv. It’s also Tel Aviv that’s approved

over 12,000 new homes in the occupied West Bank

 this year, providing $431m to support 34 new settlements. And the individualised focus on so-called “Jewish terrorism” by the New York Times obscures the fact that what’s happening across the Palestinian territories is, as we’ve seen all too clearly time and again, Israeli state terrorism. 


Just this weekend, the Israeli military

stood by once more

 as some 60 settlers stormed the Palestinian village of Qusra, before firing tear gas into the home of a Palestinian family the settlers were trying to force out. This morning, reports emerged of the military

pulling down homes in Nablus and Ramallah

. And Haaretz has today suggested that, for the country’s prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu …

Kural bi vê xebatê bîra devkî ya muzîka kurdî, şopên erdnîgariyê, bîra kesane û bêdengiyê digihîne hev ku sê vegotinên muzîkê yên cûda ne.


Strana yekem a EPê "Medrenge" ye ku awazeke kevneşopiya herêma Serhedê ye ku bi aranjmaneke nûjen digihîne guhdaran. Di vê berhema ku Kural bixwe berhev kiriye de, Nurcan Degirmencî, Meral Tekçî, Hîvda Gokel û Zelal Gokçe bi vokalên xwe cih digirin.

author: Freedom Shop Aotearoa
title: Burning Women
content:
This article is presented as two imposed PDFs intended to be printed on A4 paper, resulting in an A5 saddle-stitched pamphlet. The first PDF is a double-sided cover intended to be printed in colour, the second double-sided inside pages intended to be printed in black and white.

Understanding the witch trials is a vital part of understanding the rise of capitalism, the family, women's roles and our relation to our bodies. Their deep importance and impact is too often neglected in even radical histories. This brief overview looks at the reasons for, and effects of, the massacre of women that took place during the rise of capitalism.

As phrased so well by Past Tense, the original publishers of this essay: "We re-issue this text in a new edition as a beginning step to understanding the significance of the witch trials. We undertake this not as a matter for mere study or as a historical curiosity: by tracing the threads of modern hierarchies and alienations to their relative origins we aspire to open up invigorating new terrains for discussion, action, regeneration of our own powers, and contestation in any of a variety of creative expressions. This piece serves to whet the appetite for deeper explanations of where we are, and how we came to be here. A fruitful reading may explode your notions of the possible.":

author: Rafael Custódio
title: Inspiração para candidatos da direita, modelo Bukele de segurança é defendido na Fiesp
content:
Investigamos o que importa para os brasileiros além do que passa na campanha eleitoral. Leia mais reportagens como essa clicando

aqui

.


O Congresso sobre segurança pública realizado pela Federação das Indústrias do Estado de São Paulo (Fiesp) nesta segunda-feira, 31 de agosto, em sua sede, foi marcado pela uníssona defesa de uma figura política: o presidente de El Salvador, Nayib Bukele. O seu modelo de encarceramento em massa, inspiração para diversos políticos brasileiros, já colocou quase 2% da população do país atrás das grades, muitas vezes, sem o devido processo legal.


A palestra do ministro da Justiça e Segurança Pública salvadorenho, Gustavo Villatoro, foi o ponto alto do encontro, quando os presentes puderam ouvir suas críticas aos defensores de direitos humanos. Segundo Villatoro, órgãos internacionais de direitos humanos fazem “manipulação” quando falam sobre as violações no país. “E todos esses pseudo defensores de direitos humanos, eles são tão hipócritas”.


O que parecia ser um evento técnico sobre o tema acabou se tornando uma

propaganda de um modelo de segurança pública que conta com o apoio de pelo menos quatro

presidenciáveis

, que citam políticas semelhantes em seus planos de governo: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), Romeu Zema (Novo) e Renan Santos (Missão).


O presidente de El Salvador é hoje um dos símbolos internacionais da direita punitivista, tendo sido elogiado, inclusive, pelo presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump. Durante sua apresentação, o ministro do país declarou, inclusive, que as organizações internacionais de direitos humanos estariam em “um complô” contra as políticas de segurança e contra o governo Bukele.


Entre as ações mais criticadas do atual governo salvadorenho, estão os decretos de estado de exceção em cadeia, prisões em massa e a suspensão de garantias processuais.

 Elementos que foram ignorados ao longo do evento. A política de Bukele foi descrita, pelo contrário, como inspiração para políticos, pesquisadores e empresários do ramo da indústria presentes.


O senador da República, candidato a governador do estado do Paraná pelo Partido Liberal (PL) de Flávio Bolsonaro, além de presidente do Conselho de Segurança da Fiesp, Sergio Moro, foi uma das vozes que defenderam a política de Bukele. Ele declarou, após a apresentação de Villatoro, que, se eleito, fundará um presídio de segurança máxima estadual e o nome será “El Salvador”, em homenagem à sua inspiração nas políticas de segurança do presidente do país da América Central.


Outro candidato a ministrar palestra no evento, o deputado federal Guilherme Derrite, que disputa uma vaga ao Senado Federal por São Paulo, pelo Progressistas, também aproveitou a oportunidade para declarar seu apoio ao modelo. Ao lado de Derrite, Moro declarou que a experiência de El Salvador foi vitoriosa “graças às políticas ali levantadas”, descritas por Villatoro, “que conseguiram transformar o país no mais seguro da América Latina”.


Por que isso importa?


A Fiesp é a maior entidade de classe da indústria brasileira e representa cerca de 130 mil indústrias de São Paulo;

A entidade participou do processo de impeachment da presidente Dilma Rousseff em 2016. Na época, Paulo Skaf era o presidente da Fiesp, cargo que também ocupa neste momento.


Quem igualmente demonstrou sua simpatia pela política de Bukele, em entrevista coletiva, foi o próprio presidente da Fiesp, Paulo Scaff. Perguntado sobre o convite, não hesitou em se descrever como “entusiasta do combate ao crime organizado” e de “exemplos do mundo”, como o salvadorenho, ponderando, em seguida, que é preciso avaliar “vantagens e desvantagens” do modelo.


Presidente da Fiesp, Paulo Skaf, colocou-se como um “entusiasta” do combate ao crime organizado


O Congresso Fiesp de Segurança Pública convidou autoridades, especialistas e lideranças empresariais para debater políticas para conter o avanço do crime organizado, na sede da instituição na Avenida Paulista, em São Paulo. Foram seis painéis com temas que discutiam desde o papel do governo no combate às organizações criminosas, até tecnologias que podem auxiliar nos conflitos.


A voz dissonante sobre o modelo de segurança pública durante o Congresso foi a do promotor de justiça Lincoln Gakyia, do Ministério Público do Estado de São Paulo (MPSP), que investiga o Primeiro Comando da Capital, o PCC, há 30 anos.


Ele lembrou os altos valores gastos com presos no Brasil e o formato com que as prisões ocorreram …

author: Publicación Abierta
title: Las escuelas porteñas y la elección nacional de CTERA
content:
Este 2 de septiembre, en las elecciones nacionales de CTERA, votá la Multicolor en todo el país por:


–

 Un salario docente que cubra la canasta básica familiar por un cargo, y que todas las sumas vayan al básico.


–

 Triplicar el presupuesto educativo. Basta de pagar la deuda externa ilegal e ilegítima, basta de beneficiar de manera impositiva a los sectores más concentrados de la economía: que toda esa plata vaya para educación, salud, vivienda y empleo.


–

 Equipos socioeducativos y de ESI en cada escuela, para abordar las problemáticas sociales producto de esta crisis, y la violencia de género generada por las políticas de ajuste y por este sistema patriarcal.


–

 Urgente inversión en edificios escolares seguros, con conectividad, para garantizar el derecho de todas y todos.


–

 Partidas presupuestarias que garanticen una alimentación nutritiva y saludable para todas nuestras infancias y adolescencias.


–

 Boleto educativo gratuito para estudiantes y docentes.


–

 Unificación nacional del sistema educativo, gestionado por universidades, sindicatos, organizaciones estudiantiles y de la comunidad.


 


Los secundarios porteños empiezan a coordinarse


Mario Hernandez


Estudiantes de escuelas secundarias cortaron Corrientes y Darwin para rechazar la reforma educativa de Jorge Macri y Mercedes Miguel. La convocatoria reunió a estudiantes del 

Lola Mora

, 

Lengüitas

, 

Yrurtia

, 

Comercial N.º 35

, 

Nacional Buenos Aires

, 

Técnica Sarmiento

, l

a René Favaloro

 y la 

Niní Marshall

, en una de las primeras acciones que expresa un intento concreto de

 coordinar

 las distintas 

luchas

 que vienen desarrollándose 

contra la reforma

 educativa impulsada por el Gobierno porteño.


Varios artículos de Martín Suárez para

Tiempo Argentino

completan el panorama de la educación en CABA.


El corte contó con el 

acompañamiento

 de 

docentes

,

 familias

, integrantes de las comunidades educativas, el sindicato 

Ademys

 y Centros de estudiantes 

terciarios

 como el del 

Joaquín V. González

, el 

Alicia

 y el 

Normal N.º 1

, cuyos estudiantes destacaban que, como 

futuros docentes

, se sienten interpelados por el ejemplo que están dando los secundarios. 

“Los chicos nos están mostrando el camino”

, señalaba una estudiante terciaria.

 “Nosotros queremos poner nuestros centros de estudiantes al servicio de defender la educación pública, apoyarlos y coordinar.”


Hasta hace pocas semanas, muchas de estas escuelas enfrentaban la reforma por separado.


El

 Yrurtia

 protagonizó una toma que terminó obligando al Ministerio de Educación a firmar un acta comprometiéndose a que la escuela no ingresaría a BA Aprende.


El 

Lola Mora

 realizó un pernocte para impedir el avance de la reforma. La Nini Marshall viene desarrollando distintas medidas y al finalizar el corte recibió el acompañamiento de las demás escuelas en una concentración frente al establecimiento.


El 

Comercial 35

 denunció que BA Aprende ya está teniendo consecuencias concretas: reorganización de cursos, pérdida de puestos de trabajo docentes y modificaciones que deterioran las condiciones de enseñanza.


Cada escuela tiene su experiencia, pero todas empiezan a identificar que 

enfrentan una misma política.

“El Yrurtia demostró que sí se puede frenar la reforma”

, comentaban varios estudiantes durante la jornada. 

“Ahora la pelea es que ninguna escuela tenga que enfrentarla sola.”


La movilización también mostró algo que empieza a repetirse en distintos conflictos educativos: la incorporación activa de docentes, familias y estudiantes terciarios. Madres y padres acompañaban el corte sosteniendo carteles contra BA Aprende y conversando con quienes se acercaban a preguntar por la protesta.


Docentes de distintas escuelas insistían en que el ataque no afecta solamente a quienes hoy cursan el secundario. 

“La educación de las futuras generaciones es algo que toda la sociedad tiene que defender”

, explicaba una mamá. 

“No podemos mirar para otro lado cuando el Gobierno modifica la escuela sin consultar a nadie.”


En ese sentido, los centros de estudiantes terciarios remarcaron que también sienten propia esta pelea 

“Somos futuros docentes. Lo que hoy está pasando en las secundarias también define las condiciones en las que vamos a enseñar mañana.”


Uno de los aspectos más significativos de la jornada fue justamente ese intento de 

coordinar entre escuelas

. Mientras crece el rechazo a 

BA Aprende …

author: Rindala Alajaji
title: EFF to Governor Newsom: Veto California’s AB 1709
content:
The California legislature passed Assembly Bill 1709 (A.B. 1709) today, which functions as a

sweeping ban on social media use

 for young people under the age of 16. This well-intentioned, but deeply flawed piece of legislation, cuts young people off from essential information and experiences, particularly harming vulnerable youth and marginalized groups who often find safety in supportive online communities they can't access offline. That’s why we’re

urging Governor Gavin Newsom to veto the measure

.

 


Should the law go into effect in January, platforms would be prohibited from offering virtually every functional recommendation algorithm and basic input, such as who a user follows or what posts they like, to anyone under 16. These so-called "addictive features," are in reality the basic tools that online services use to identify what other user-generated content a particular user might want to see. Users also rely on these features to find audiences for their own speech, as well as community. By labeling these basic tools as "addictive," the bill relies on sweeping generalizations regarding the

unsettled science

 of youth social media use. Because nearly every major service relies on automated feeds, the ultimate result is that young people under 16 will still be locked out of major digital services as they currently exist.

 


A.B. 1709 is a massive privacy and free speech nightmare.


A.B. 1709 is a massive privacy and free speech nightmare. Denying young people access to digital forums (or stripping out the basic tools needed to navigate them) does nothing to make young people safer or healthier. Research shows that social media bans are

ineffectual

, and can be harmful when they deny young people opportunities to develop their own voices and perspectives, whether that means sharing art, practicing religion, or engaging in politics.

 


Far from protecting children, the bill will also severely restrict access to constitutionally protected speech and push platforms to implement invasive age-verification methods, such as requiring government IDs or biometric scanning. Age-gating requirements will force everyone to give big tech companies even more personal

information

. To verify who can pass through online gates, companies will collect even more data,

concentrating power

 in corporate hands rather than protecting users. This creates massive honeypots of

sensitive personal data

, severely damages online

anonymity

, and exposes users of all ages to

heightened


data breach


risks

.

 


Finally, A.B. 1709 introduces legal confusion by creating provisions that conflict with already enacted legislation like

A.B. 1043

 and

S.B. 976

author: Sara Connors
title: Yukon wildfire agency wants to know why it didn’t get called to B.C.
content:
Yukon First Nations Wildfire is questioning why international crews were deployed to help with wildfires in British Columbia this summer while its own resources remained available – a situation it says has left it feeling sidelined.


As particularly intense wildfires

burned across southern B.C.

 in late July into August, international firefighting crews from as far away as Australia, New Zealand and Mexico were called in to help.


But

Yukon First Nations Wildfire (YFNW)

 says its crews didn’t receive the same opportunity.


“Everybody trains all summer to be able to go out on these deployments, and then they aren’t allowed to when the when the time comes. It makes them feel less than or unequal to,” YFNW CEO Nick Mauro told APTN News. “It is really frustrating.”


Mauro said that for the past five years, its crews have been deployed outside the territory through the Yukon government, with the

Canadian Interagency Forest Fire Centre (CIFFC)

 coordinating the sharing of wildfire resources between provinces and territories.


But he said this year YFNW hasn’t had any deployments through the territorial government.


“(It’s) really frustrating when you have international crews flying in from other continents, and we’re being told that there’s not enough money to drive our crews from the Yukon down south,” he said.


Nick Mauro is the CEO of Yukon First Nations Wildfire. Photo: Jordan Haslbeck/APTN News


A private contractor owned by First Nations development corporations, YFNW offers Type 2-certified firefighting crews, which are trained to support a variety of lower-risk wildfire operations and are employed through contract companies.


They differ from Type 1 crews, which have the highest level of training and are employed directly by provincial or territorial wildfire services.


Sarah Buss, a fire information officer with BC Wildfire Service, said in an email to APTN News that while it recognizes the important role Indigenous crews play in wildfire response, because YFNW is located outside of the province, it would have to be deployed through the Yukon government, with CIFFC coordinating that request.


Meanwhile, Mike Fancie, a spokesperson with Yukon Wildland Fire Management, said that a request first has to come through another jurisdiction, and that B.C. hasn’t requested the type of crew that YFNW provides.


He also noted that the territory can’t force other provinces and territories to accept a resource’s offer to help.


“We are always glad to work with YFNW to support our shared goal of helping people in their time of need, but we cannot promise them fireline opportunities on behalf of other jurisdictions,” he said.


The situation isn’t a surprise to Arnold Lazare, interim CEO with the

National Indigenous Fire Safety Council

, which aims to support Indigenous fire safety programs and capacity.


“There is definitely a disconnect when it comes to the resources being allocated to Indigenous communities,” he said.


He said interjurisdictional barriers involving issues like workers’ compensation and safety, as well as the lack of an accredited national training program, can impact the ability of Indigenous wildfire crews to be deployed.


“That’s where things start getting mixed up,” he said.


He argued that governments could reduce their dependence on foreign firefighters by investing more into Indigenous fire crews closer to home.


He said the council is hoping to create a nationally accredited training program that could be used as a Canada-wide resource, making it easier to deploy Indigenous wildfire crews when and where they’re needed.


Mauro said while he understands the current system wasn’t designed to prioritize the types of resources


YFNW provides, he believes it doesn’t have to stay that way.


He said he’s optimistic there will eventually be systemic changes that will allow local Indigenous wildfire crews like YFNW the right of first refusal before international resources are deployed.


“We want to see the same and equal opportunity for Indigenous crews across Canada, that’s really what matters most to us,” he said. “I’m really hoping that as we continue, there are those in positions of power that are able to help us out.”


A spokesperson for CIFFC said in a statement its working with Indigenous partners to better understand and address barriers to deploying Indigenous wildfire resources.
